import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { executeBackendCaveCommand, sendCaveCommandFallback } from '@src/api/bot/cave-command';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { sendVisitedCavePlotPage } from '@src/response/cavePlot/render';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse, useMention } from 'alemonjs';

type SocialAction = 'water' | 'worm' | 'weed' | 'harvest';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const [mention] = useMention();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const text = (e.MessageText ?? '').trim();
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();
  let title = '灵田互动';

  if (/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?偷药/.test(text)) {
    const parsed = await parseStealCommand(text, mention);

    if (!parsed) {
      md.addText('格式错误，示例：/偷药 123、/偷药 @目标 或 /偷药 123 2');
    } else {
      const result = await executeBackendCaveCommand(
        String(bid),
        uid,
        { action: 'steal', ownerId: parsed.targetUid, ownerBid: parsed.ownerBid, plotIndex: parsed.plotIndex },
        createBackendRequestContext(e)
      );

      if (result.snapshotError) {
        sendCaveCommandFallback(result, bid, isPrivate, message, '灵田互动');

        return;
      }
      const overview = result.visit;
      const footer = [
        { label: '查看信息', command: `/查看信息 ${result.ownerUid ?? parsed.targetUid}` },
        { label: '我的灵田', command: '/灵田' }
      ];

      if (overview) {
        sendVisitedCavePlotPage({
          title: '偷药',
          bid,
          isPrivate,
          message,
          overview,
          leadText: result.message,
          footer
        });

        return;
      }

      title = '偷药';
      md.addText(result.message);
    }
  } else {
    const parsed = await parseCollaborateCommand(text, mention);

    if (!parsed) {
      md.addText('格式错误，示例：/协作灵田 123 浇灌 2 或 /协作灵田 @目标 浇灌 2');
    } else {
      const result = await executeBackendCaveCommand(
        String(bid),
        uid,
        { action: 'collaborate', ownerId: parsed.targetUid, ownerBid: parsed.ownerBid, careAction: parsed.action, plotIndex: parsed.plotIndex },
        createBackendRequestContext(e)
      );

      if (result.snapshotError) {
        sendCaveCommandFallback(result, bid, isPrivate, message, '灵田互动');

        return;
      }
      const overview = result.visit;

      if (overview) {
        const footer = [
          { label: '查看信息', command: `/查看信息 ${result.ownerUid ?? parsed.targetUid}` },
          { label: '我的灵田', command: '/灵田' }
        ];

        sendVisitedCavePlotPage({
          title: '协作灵田',
          bid,
          isPrivate,
          message,
          overview,
          leadText: result.message,
          footer
        });

        return;
      }

      title = '协作灵田';
      md.addText(result.message);
    }
  }

  const footer = [{ label: '我的灵田', command: '/灵田' }];

  void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title, content: md, footer }));
});

async function parseCollaborateCommand(messageText: string, mention?: any) {
  const match = messageText.match(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?协作灵田\s+(.+?)\s+(浇灌|除虫|除草|收割)(?:\s+(\d+))?$/u);

  if (!match) {
    return null;
  }

  const targetUid = /^\d+$/.test(match[2]) ? Number(match[2]) : undefined;
  const ownerBid = targetUid === undefined ? await resolveMentionBid(mention) : undefined;
  const actionText = match[3];
  const plotIndex = match[4] ? Number(match[4]) : undefined;
  const actionMap: Record<string, SocialAction> = {
    浇灌: 'water',
    除虫: 'worm',
    除草: 'weed',
    收割: 'harvest'
  };

  if ((!targetUid || targetUid <= 0) && !ownerBid) {
    return null;
  }

  return {
    targetUid,
    ownerBid,
    action: actionMap[actionText],
    plotIndex
  };
}

async function parseStealCommand(messageText: string, mention?: any) {
  const match = messageText.match(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?偷药\s+(.+?)(?:\s+(\d+))?$/u);

  if (!match) {
    return null;
  }

  const targetUid = /^\d+$/.test(match[2]) ? Number(match[2]) : undefined;
  const ownerBid = targetUid === undefined ? await resolveMentionBid(mention) : undefined;
  const plotIndex = match[3] ? Number(match[3]) : undefined;

  if ((!targetUid || targetUid <= 0) && !ownerBid) {
    return null;
  }

  return { targetUid, ownerBid, plotIndex };
}

async function resolveMentionBid(mention?: { findOne: () => Promise<{ count?: number; data?: { UserId?: string | null } | null }> }) {
  const user = await mention?.findOne();

  return user?.count && user.data?.UserId ? user.data.UserId : undefined;
}
